messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: high p95 latency on inference-proxy-prod (rule: prod.p95.latency > 450ms)
IncidentBot: PD Incident ID: PD-87233, paging escalation to oncall
Dana: acked PD-87233 :thumbsup: seeing alert in dashboard now
Omar: ack'd, looking at tail of proxy logs and traces, starting with recent deploys
Aisha: I see a ~3m spike in request rate to the primary pool around 02:33 UTC, could be a canary run?
Priya: @Aisha can you check if the loadtest job kicked off around that time? we had one scheduled for midnight but might've drifted
Omar: logs show many 503->retry attempts then higher latencies, backend gRPC queueing increases. attaching snippet:
```
proxy: upstream_apply_latency_ms p95=612 p50=210 p99=980
upstream: grpc_connection_pool_exhausted
```
Dana: trying a quick mitigation: bumping dedicated pool min-replicas to +2, and temporarily pinning traffic away from pool-a -> pool-b
SRE Oncall: run: `rdctl pool scale --pool pool-a --min 6`
Omar: also enabling kv-cache prewarm for active models: `infractl kv-warm --model t5-large --scope pool-a`
IncidentBot: PD-87233 marked acknowledged by Dana
CS Ops: any customer-facing errors? I'm checking support queue now
Dana: support queue shows one internal error reported by internal canary run, no customer tickets so far, marking customer impact = none (tentative)
Aisha: confirmed loadtest job did start accidentally at 02:31 UTC (cron drift), it hit the inference proxy with bursty traffic to pool-a
Priya: thanks — will mute the test job and add a hard guard on the cron schedule to avoid overlapping windows
Omar: p95 is dropping back down after scale and prewarm, current p95 210ms, p99 420ms
Dana: PD auto-resolved at 02:42 UTC :white_check_mark:
SRE Oncall: quick postmortem notes: cause = accidental loadtest overlap hitting primary pool causing transient queue exhaustion; mitigation = scale up pool, prewarm kv-cache, re-route traffic; customer impact = none; next steps = add cron guard + alert to devex to avoid scheduling during high-traffic windows
Priya: creating a follow-up ticket: INF-3421 with action items and owners
CS Ops: looping in support to keep watch for any delayed reports, will update if anything comes up
Omar: handoff to next oncall (Aisha) — please monitor dashboards for next 30m, I'll be offline in 10m
Aisha: ack, monitoring. thanks team :heart:
Dana: nice quick mitigation, good call on kv-warm. closing thread.
